newsitem.title: CHINA: SHENZHEN FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET UP 71 PCT.
newsitem.headline: SHENZHEN FANGDA FIRST-HALF NET UP 71 PCT.

text.p: Results for the half-year ended June 30, 1997 (year-on-year in millions of yuan unless otherwise stated):
Earnings per share 0.315 yuan vs 0.301 yuan
Net assets per share 3.02 yuan vs 2.41 yuan
Company name: Shenzhen Fangda Industrial Co Ltd.
Note: The unaudited results, under Chinese accounting standards except for net profits which were based on international standards, were published in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times on Tuesday.
Based on Chinese accounting standards, the building materials producer posted net profits of 75.6 million yuan for the first six months of 1997 against 45.1 million yuan a year-ago.
Trading in the company's A and B shares was suspended on Tuesday morning for the result announcement but will resume in the afternoon, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said.
